verdict.rationale: Cal.com runs a versioned REST API: endpoints sit under a /v2 path, and the docs say the official CLI "handles authentication, versioning" automatically. The docs also label one auth method "Platform (Deprecated)", so deprecations are flagged, but the evidence contains no published deprecation policy, timelines or migration guarantees. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with notice periods, a documented version-selection mechanism and changelog, independent corroboration of version stability.
